source.wallClock: Unmodified real wall clock and event timestamps. No byte-equality prediction.

inheritedSource.preservation: Existing verifier checks all old references, failed Source v1 and 13 full historical production trees. No old input or raw is rewritten.

helperReuse.reason: Same two Window-opaque observation guards and recorder.
Same lossless streaming JSON plus gzip writer.

caller: Public DatePicker only; picker=date by omission. Controlled value/open. Presets omitted in two date-only owners. Stable Dayjs/style/callback/preset references. No Native module or reference is imported, and no Source callback is directly called.
format: Two retained-calendar owners: valid June12 rejected by value owner, and disabled June15. Only format changes while open and closed; actual controlled value identity is retained. The disabled June15 owner omits defaultPickerValue to observe same-month picker-value requests.
navigation: Six bounded owners: omitted/explicit defaultPickerValue, controlled pickerValue June1 with reject/accept, min and max clamp. Initial controlled-picker open requests are recorded separately from preset action; no callback count or panel result is assumed.
datetime: Exact off-grid static preset 2024-06-13T16:37:59.456 with steps2/15/10/100. Actual hour/minute/second/millisecond hovers, 12h meridiem and disabled hour/all-AM cases. Preview false/hover switches and leave/close/reopen are observed without rounding expectations.
dateOnly: No-presets date-only owner preserves a time-bearing model while rendering full precision and changing only format during hover. Second no-presets owner changes only minDate to June19 while pointer remains over June18, then leaves, closes/reopens and hovers an enabled control date.
choreography: Open/preset/cell/time hover use physical Playwright pointer actions. Input focus is an actual DOM focus action; input Escape is real keyboard input after an explicit focus observation. Prop updates use actual authored HTMLElement.click inside ReactDOM.flushSync, changing exactly the named owner state without moving pointer or focus. No imperative calendar/hover/value reset or synthetic library callback is used.
observations: Full current DOM topology/HTML/ordered attributes and inline CSSOM, all prior computed CSS and boxes, actual time-column scroll/selected/disabled data, input value/defaultValue/caret/focus, all calendar cells, public ref/method identities, FormData and popup ancestry. Full callback argument count/receiver/raw graphs/order, all disabledDate/disabledTime/disabledHours actual producer calls and return graphs, actual Dayjs epoch/ISO/offset/7fields and authored identity aliases.
SourceNativeBoundary: Actual Source onPickerValueChange(value,cleanInfo) is retained unchanged. Native existing public callback arity1, calendar info and native HTML input focus contract remain separate later review questions; this Source counter does not normalize them.
SSR: Each of 13 initial closed owners is rendered with both actual serializers in a fresh DOM-free VM. Actual pure producer counts are retained, not assumed zero. Callback/factory idleness, null refs and resource traps are inspected from actual results. No open portal markup or hydration result is invented.
closedAndCleanup: Every observed open-to-closed transition keeps afterCall, settled and actual +1000ms observations. Actual public owner unmount then cleanup and +1000ms retain disconnected Source-owned nodes and cleared refs. Browser-owned resource counters remain honestly unmeasured/null; requests and real ResourceTiming remain raw.
storage: Each full point is streamed immediately into its own JSON plus lossless gzip part. No fields or raw identities are omitted. Manifest stores exact bytes and hashes, keeping one point/case in memory and preserving any failed partial parts.
repeat: Four fresh processes in serial: CSR first/repeat, SSR first/repeat. Both complete originals are retained independently. Compare bytes first and enumerate actual differences without normalizing timestamps, identity IDs, paths or data.
